reply_text:
@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline in #inc-vtg-hartford at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**. That message says the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

Between that report and kiosk 1 coming back at 11:03, the channel only records the guard writing trailer numbers on the clipboard. At 11:03 Mateo Quiroga posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did. For more detail, ask Mateo or check INC-4821.
